title: Trump unveils “Super Intelligence Force” to oversee AI policy
dek: The new task force is presented as the administration’s latest response to debate over AI safety.
body:
President Trump announced a new body called the “Super Intelligence Force” intended to oversee and coordinate U.S. AI policy. The announcement frames the task force as a response to ongoing debates about AI safety and governance.

## Why it matters

The U.S. is debating how to manage risks from advanced AI systems, and this announcement signals the administration intends to put a dedicated body at the center of that effort. A named, centralized force could change how federal AI policy is coordinated across agencies and how the government engages with companies and researchers , but the specifics that determine its influence are not yet public.

## The details

- The group is called the “Super Intelligence Force.”
- The stated purpose is to oversee or coordinate U.S. AI policy.
- The White House presented the force as the administration’s latest response to the debate over AI safety.
- Coverage of the announcement appeared in multiple outlets reporting the launch and the intended role in U.S. AI policy.
- Public reporting has not yet provided full details on the force’s membership, legal authority, budget, or how it will interact with existing agencies.

## What to watch

Look for formal documents or an executive order that define the force’s authority, staffing and funding — those will determine whether it changes policy or mainly serves as a coordinating body. Also watch how existing agencies and industry groups react; their cooperation will be critical for any meaningful oversight role.

Source: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/04/trump-unveils-his-new-super-intelligence-force/)
